cases.case_label: Full-length L1 in PTEN 3' UTR (pediatric germ cell tumor)
cases.disease: Pediatric sacrococcygeal germ cell tumor (possible PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome predisposition)
cases.mechanism_detail: A unique germline full-length L1 in the PTEN 3' UTR (downstream of the 7th of 16 polyA sites) was associated in blood RNA-seq with reduced usage of the downstream polyA sites (loss of long 3' UTR isoforms) and lower PTEN TPM; causality for the tumour is proposed, not established. (A STIM1 intronic SVA with exonization in a T-ALL patient was not considered a driver and is not recorded.)
cases.quote: Together, these observations suggest that the L1 insertion in the 3′ UTR of PTEN disrupts longer transcript isoforms, impairing its expression.
